findings.issue: Registered prospective diagnostics of the same VIS07 experiment are executed and scored but absent from the ledger and from every public report. Mean over 5 seeds on the 1,797-image TEST: shifted-crop condition NeuroPixel 55.826% vs CNN 85.120% (NeuroPixel 29.3 pp worse); half-intensity NeuroPixel 88.737% vs CNN 67.056% (NeuroPixel better). The base 94.357% vs 90.840% is reported; the shift negative is not. VIS07_protocol.md says 'Preservar negativos' and README.md:29 answers 'Are the negative results preserved? Yes.' A grep of README, docs/papers/*.md, VIS07_results.md and RESULTS_INDEX finds no mention of the shift or half-intensity results.
findings.evidence: results/research/VIS07MAIN_cloud/37908785698/raw.zip:result.json scores[condition in {base, half_intensity, shift_right_crop}] (5 seeds x 2 families each); docs/research/VIS07_protocol.md:11; docs/research/VIS07_results.md (no mention); README.md:29
findings.suggested_fix: Register a new L2 claim (VIS07 prospective diagnostics, both conditions, both directions) bound to raw.zip; add to D-VIS07-01 limits that robustness to a 1-column shift was far worse than the CNN (55.8% vs 85.1%); amend VIS07_results.md and README; keep the +3.517 pp claim scoped to the base TEST condition.

findings.evidence: claim_candidates S003-L0037 (docs/papers/NeuroPixel_manuscript_20261009.md:37); ledger D-VIS07-01.statement and limits (no writer-verification limit)

findings.issue: Statement says the historical router exceeded a uniform mixture (+17.546, CI +3.069 to +32.022) and a random router (+16.178) but omits that the random-router interval (-2.434 to +34.791) includes zero, and the limits omit the retrospective Holm result: the uniform contrast has unadjusted p=0.0413 and Holm p=1.0; none of 40 contrasts survives. Only the word 'unadjusted' is present. H06-05 carries the Holm limit; H06-06 does not. H06-03 also omits the T1-vs-T16 interval [-14.123; +14.416].
findings.evidence: docs/research/06_A06_1_results.md:32,41-42; results/research/06_A06_1_recovery/multiplicity_sensitivity.json contrasts['fixed legacy minus uniform'] holm_p=1.0, 'fixed legacy minus random' unadjusted_p=0.0575; survive_holm_005=[]
findings.suggested_fix: Add the random-router CI (includes zero) to the statement and the Holm sensitivity to the limits of H06-06; add the T1-vs-T16 CI to H06-03.

findings.issue: Declared L2 / experiment_complete for a diagnostic that the statement itself calls post hoc, whose limit says it is 'not a frozen endpoint', and which was recounted by the completion phase because the report's diagnostic file is absent. That does not meet 'frozen protocol and all units executed'; L1 (recount of retained predictions) is the supportable level.
findings.suggested_fix: Lower to engineering_complete / L1, or keep L2 only with an explicit statement that it is exploratory and outside the frozen endpoint list.

findings.issue: Arguably over-levelled L2: D-SCN06-02 is a deterministic rank census of 5 old matrices whose receipt status is 'verified_retrospective_SCN06_ambient_matrix_census' (the word retrospective is missing from the statement); D-SCN06-01 is a hand-assigned counterexample (one constructed experiment, 0.009 s wall); D-QT-03 is descriptive curve reading; P-COST-01 is a derived timing sum. All have a frozen plan so the rule is formally met, but none has statistical units.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'retrospective' to D-SCN06-02; consider L1 for the census and the timing sum, or add a limit saying there are no statistical units.

findings.issue: Receipts are archive-custody records that do not contain the figures they are meant to support: VIS07MAIN/37908785698/receipt.json and VIS07REPLAY/37911162172/receipt.json hold only workflow id, commit, zip hash and file count; SCN06_cloud/37896280187/receipt.json likewise. findings.issue: Reports the training-matched-mode joint values (88.593/80.621/84.808%) without the dense-mode values 80.176/79.785/63.184% for the same cell; the report says both are kept and not chosen by score. Neither statement nor limits mention the mode distinction (D-QT-03 does).

findings.issue: 'Used less board energy in four of seven workloads' compares medians of three technical blocks; technical min-max ranges overlap in C16/grid8 (render 0.282-0.374 vs graph 0.277-1.228 J) and RGB8 (render 0.180-0.336 vs graph 0.315-0.317 J), and the 'more' cases C48/grid8 and grid32 differ by about 1% (0.3325 vs 0.3282; 0.3844 vs 0.3796). Only C16/grid32 and C16/grid128 are separated by non-overlapping ranges. The same remark applies to G-R10-01: RENDER10 range_ms spans cuda_graph 0.52-4.19 ms at C16/grid8 where the compute win is 1.06x.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'technical ranges overlap in 5 of 7 workloads' to the statement or limits.

findings.issue: Positive historical NeuroPixel result (96.131% vs 7.320% binding) drops source qualifiers: n=3 coupled seeds cannot isolate variances and no historical significance decision was made; the result describes these trained models, not Transformers as a family; seed-2 scores are normalized snapshots from the user's own project. L0 is correct (raw evidence absent).

notes.method: Read all 73 statements and limits against current and archived source reports (docs/archive/completion_20261012/A18_sources for the 11 files edited in A18.3); read all 223 editorial/method/governance lines plus all 91 restatement lines of the four claim_review files; opened 55 receipt files (JSON fields, zip members) and compared sha256 of 16 protocol files with report-stated hashes.
